paragraphs: Mentioned in Mekhilta, Beshalach, tractate Vayehi, chapter 3; R' Natan reported in his name.[^1]

notes.text: מס׳ ויהי פ״ג is read as tractate Vayehi chapter 3 within Mekhilta Beshalach, without an independently checked named edition or renumbering. Natan reports Abba Yosi’s name, not the reverse. Abba is explicit and Natan’s title remains R'.
